share_notes.name: notes
share_notes.said:
You lend notes (port 51403) to everyone in your groups, as many at once as want it. To let fewer in at once, change it on your home page, or `svrngs share 51403 --limit <number>`.
svrngs is running here already, so they can open it now.
`svrngs unshare notes` stops lending it.

link_again.said:
A new link to mesh. Any link you sent before stops letting anyone new in; everyone it let in stays.
It works for a day, while this computer is on:

  svrngs://join/<the token>

Leave this running; Ctrl-C stops it.
